defectsFoundThisSession.summary: 08_AuditContract.sql applies the contract with a cursor over sys.tables at position 9 of 37, so tables created by scripts 30-47 never received it. One ordered pass on an empty server left 19 tables short by 147 columns and 19 filtered indexes, including Timeline.Event and Intelligence.UserStateSnapshot.
defectsFoundThisSession.whyHidden: Every verification database had been re-applied more than once; a second pass picks the later tables up by accident. AuditContractTests was correct and green throughout.
defectsFoundThisSession.fix: Cursor extracted to dbo.usp_ApplyAuditContract, called by 08 and again by 48_AuditContract_Apply.sql after every table exists. tests/audit_contract_test.sql guards it, and CI runs it as its own step.
defectsFoundThisSession.lesson: A green test on an incrementally re-applied database proves the schema converges, not that the documented procedure produces it.
